g.text: The original signed spectral filter and its full-state map
All three shifts, all five moments and both tails retained [JTR11–JTR13]
This is the exact scalar filter, not a spectral-density plot. Both negative tails remain in its integral.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Exact difference from the trace vector, with no commutation of the coupling:
The identities also hold at the original ζ = θκ*/j. Actual weights in the positive interval
and both negative tails remain to be evaluated; total coupling alone does not allocate them.
Complete original domains, general ε and R coefficients, and proofs: JTR11–JTR13.
